name: Custom Shape 6-Layer Wooden and Acrylic Piggy Bank
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from a combination of high-quality wood and durable acrylic, offering a sturdy, modern, and eye-catching display finish.
    - Features a 6-layer construction that creates a dimensional 3D effect and a more vivid decorative appearance.
    - Layer 1 and Layer 6 are made of acrylic with a 2mm thickness, providing a clear and polished outer surface.
    - Layer 2, Layer 3, Layer 4, and Layer 5 are made of wood with 5mm thickness, creating a solid structure and warm, handcrafted look.
    - Secured with screws for stable assembly and long-term use.
    - Includes up to 10 screws with 5mm screw length for convenient installation.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available sizes:
                  +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
                  +) 8 x 8 in ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm
                  +) 10 x 10 in ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Layer 1 and Layer 6: 2-sided printing.
    - Layer 2, Layer 3, Layer 4, and Layer 5: 1-sided printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a savings bank and a personalized decorative keepsake.
    - Designed to store cash securely while also serving as a fun and meaningful display piece.
    - Transparent acrylic layers allow users to see the money inside, making saving more interactive and enjoyable.
    - Suitable for desks, shelves, bedrooms, living rooms, and gift display corners.
    - Perfect for kids, teens, and adults who want a creative way to save money and decorate their space.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for kids, family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, graduations, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for money-saving goals, personalized room décor, and themed keepsakes.
    - A thoughtful gift for children, students, surfers, travelers, and anyone who enjoys custom decorative accessories.
    - Great for home décor, desk display, and memorable milestone gifts.
    - Adds a fun, creative, and personal touch to any space🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 6-Layer Wooden and Acrylic Piggy Bank

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
